The files in this folder are from the Ansible project (https://github.com/ansible/ansible) and are licensed with the GPLv3 license. They're the NetBSD `ifconfig -a` outputs `NETBSD_IFCONFIG_A_OUT_7_1` and `NETBSD_IFCONFIG_A_OUT_POST_7_1` from `test/units/module_utils/facts/network/test_generic_bsd.py` (commit 4761c59c9639ff70d4db2b91b7361e121d482301), copied unmodified into their own files (Ansible indents them with spaces, where NetBSD uses tabs). They're only used as input data for unit tests.
